# Pairee
> A modern, dual-pane, modular terminal file manager (TUI) written in Rust with Ratatui and Tokio.

Pairee combines the classic visual convenience of double-panel navigation (inspired by Norton Commander) with modern asynchronous operations, customizable keyboard shortcuts, dynamic themes, multi-language support, and a smart self-updater.

## Key Resources
- [Pairee Official Website](https://pairee.fitty.ar): Landing page and presentation.
- [Plugin Store](https://pairee.fitty.ar/plugins.html): Community plugin catalog.
- [Changelog](https://pairee.fitty.ar/changelog.html): Release history.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/FittyAr/Pairee): Main source code repository.
- [Latest Releases](https://github.com/FittyAr/Pairee/releases): Release logs and precompiled binaries.

## Features
- **Dual-Pane Interface**: Parallel navigation to copy/move/delete without losing context.
- **Asynchronous Engine**: Non-blocking operations powered by Tokio runtime.
- **Customizable Control Profiles**: Presets for Norton/Far, Explorer/VS Code/Total Commander, Neovim and yazi; any key can be changed.
- **Dynamic Styling**: Customizable Slate, Blue, and other themes.
- **Self-Updater**: Supports up to 13 installation channels, verifying releases with minisign signatures and SHA-256 checksums.
- **Extra Tools**: Directory comparison, duplicate finder, Git integration, SSH/SFTP, zip/tar/7z archives, process manager, text/file finder and attribute panel.
- **Lua Plugins**: Sandboxed Lua plugin API with a community catalog.

## Quick Installation

### Linux / macOS
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FittyAr/Pairee/master/install.sh | sh
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FittyAr/Pairee/master/install.ps1 | iex
```
